sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete a minimum total of 150 units, which includes all of the following.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: One of the following minors from the Faculty of Education (may be fully or partially completed during EDUC 404). Lists: Counselling and Human Development Minor Program, Curriculum and Instruction Minor Program, Early Learning Minor Program, Educational Psychology Minor Program, Elementary Generalist Minor Program, Environmental Education Minor Program, French Education Minor Program, International and Global Education Minor Program, Learning and Developmental Disabilities Minor Program, Physical and Health Education Minor Program, Secondary Mathematics Education Minor Program, Secondary Teaching Minor Program, Social Justice in Education, two of.
